picked.by: read off a gridded view by eye, then snapped

corner_order: TL, TR, BR, BL of the flat panel with the panel's own up pointing up, clockwise as seen on the render; quad[k] is where the dieline rectangle's corner k lands

closed.front.note: the closed box's large face; the edge from the left corner to the top corner is the top of the print, as the agency scene reads

closed.wall_left.note: the thin wall along the face's lower-left edge

closed.wall_front.note: the thin wall along the face's lower-right edge; the agency scene shows the lockup line here

open.lid_wall_top.note: the inner face of the lid's top wall, the wedge between the lid's rim and the flat inside; widest at the top-left corner
open.lid_wall_top.picked: read off gridded 2x crops, round 2; the flat inner colour, no print

open.lid_wall_left.note: the inner face of the lid's left wall, the band along the flat inside's left edge; its inner edge overlaps the inside, which is composed after
open.lid_wall_left.picked: read off gridded 2x crops, round 2; the flat inner colour, no print

open.lid_ear_left.note: the folded tuck ear at the lid's top-left corner; a curved flap read as a quad
open.lid_ear_left.picked: read off gridded 2x crops, round 2; the flat inner colour, no print

open.lid_inside.note: the flat inside of the upright lid, inside its rim; round 2: the top-left corner moved out to the fold (the snap had pulled it 40 px inward and left a grey strip against the wall)

open.tray_top.note: the top of the tray between the lid hinge and the fold of the flap

open.flap.note: the front flap folded down; the die-cut shows the floor behind it; its top edge is the fold, the tray top's front edge (round 2: moving it down opened a strip of bare render between the two panels; the render's fold is a thin dark line, not a rim); shade floor 0.55 so the first line, 8 px under the crease on the dieline, stays legible in the fold's shadow

open.wall_right.note: the outer face of the near right wall, below the tray's right edge

open.wall_far.note: the inner face of the far left wall, seen from above the tray, from the tray's edge to the wall's rim; the inner flat colour, no print (round 2: the outer corner brought in to the base's corner)

open.lid_wall_right_upper.note: the lid's outer right wall, upper half, from the rim; the front's gradient continues round the edge

open.lid_wall_right_lower.note: the lid's outer right wall, lower half, to the lid's bottom-right corner; the wall bows, read off a 2x crop

box_mask.how: union of every panel quad, minus holes with fill render, dilated 2 px

background.how: outside the box mask dilated 40 px; the far ring outside 300 px
